paragraphs.text: Nowadays many people work from home instead of going to the office.
this is good for workers and also for companies, but there are some problems too.
workers do not need to travel, so they save time and money.
companies can pay less for offices…

answers.why: Clear position · relevant main ideas · simple, sometimes repetitive linking · limited range of vocabulary and some grammar errors.

paragraphs.text: In recent years, working from home has become far more common.
it brings real benefits to both employees and employers, although it has some disadvantages.
employees avoid long commutes, which gives them more time for rest.
businesses can reduce the cost of renting office space…

answers.why: Clear position throughout · logical paragraphs with a range of linkers · good vocabulary with some less common words · mostly accurate complex sentences.

modelWhy.task1: Clear overview of the main trends · key features selected and compared with accurate figures · logical paragraphs with varied linking · precise, less common vocabulary for describing change.
modelWhy.task2: Clear position from the first paragraph · each main idea developed with a relevant example · varied, natural linking · precise vocabulary and a wide range of accurate complex sentences.
